product.description: DESCOPERĂ PICTOGRAMELE ȘI ÎNCEPE SĂ CITEȘTI CU AJUTOR!   Ascultă povestea pe care părintele tău o citește cu voce tare și participă la lectură rostind cuvintele reprezentate prin imagini. În felul acesta vei urmări mai ușor firul poveștii, iar lectura va deveni una dintre activitățile tale preferate. Această serie cu pictograme: • încurajează și dezvoltă abilitățile de citire. • este perfectă pentru momentele împreună cu cel mic. • este ideală ca poveste de seară, dar și pentru orice moment al zilei.   Prima mea lectură este o colecție special creată pentru a-i ghida pas cu pas pe preșcolari și pe școlari în aventura cititului. Formatul accesibil, textele ilustrate și adaptate la nivelul de înțelegere al vârstei, succesul de care se bucură aceste cărți în lumea întreagă și premiile primite îi motivează pe copii să-și cultive interesul pentru lectură. # The Princess and the Pea Story with Pictograms: Guided Reading for Beginners (Level 1) Developing a love for reading begins with engaging and supportive tools. *The Princess and the Pea* is brought to life in this special storybook series from Litera, designed specifically to guide young readers through the exciting adventure of learning to read using visual pictograms. This Level 1 book helps preschoolers and early school-age children build confidence and skills one colorful page at a time. ## Master Reading Skills with Pictogram Support This collection is more than just a storybookâit's an interactive guide for developing foundational literacy skills. Through the engaging narrative of "The Princess and the Pea," children learn to follow the plot while simultaneously decoding words represented by clear images. When reading together, parents can read the story aloud while pointing out the pictograms, allowing the child to actively participate in tracking the flow of the story. This format makes: * **Reading Accessible:** The combination of familiar stories and visual cues helps children follow the narrative arc easily. * **Learning Fun:** Reading becomes a preferred activity, transforming what might be challenging into an enjoyable shared moment. * **Skill Building:** It effectively encourages and develops crucial early reading abilities in a supportive environment. Whether itâs intended as a calming bedtime story or a fun daytime learning activity, this book is perfect for moments spent connecting with your little one. ## Designed for Progressive Learning: The Litera Series Guide This initial title marks the beginning of an acclaimed series developed to transition children smoothly from foundational concepts to independent reading. Each level builds upon the last, ensuring continuous engagement and skill reinforcement. The comprehensive series includes multiple levels suitable for a wide age range: * **Level 1:** Ideal for ages 5â6 years * **Level 2:** Suitable for ages 6â7 years * **Level 3:** Designed for ages 6â7 years * **Level 4:** For older children, aged 7â8 years * **Level 5:** Perfect for ages 8â9 years * **Level 6:** Continues development for ages 8â9 years The clear, illustrated texts and age-appropriate content have earned global recognition for their effectiveness in fostering a love of literature. ## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) **Q: Is this book suitable for my child who has never read before?** A: Yes. The pictogram format is specifically designed to guide beginners (Level 1, ages 5-6). By combining the familiar story structure with visual representations of words, it makes reading feel achievable and fun, even for first-time readers. **Q: How does the book help with general literacy skills?** A: Beyond just recognizing letters, the pictograms help children build context clues and associate images with written language. This strengthens comprehension while they are developing their decoding skills in a structured way. *** **Product Details:** * **Brand:** Litera * **Category:** Children's Books / Early Readers * **Price:** $24.99 * **Purchase Link:** [Affiliate Link] (Click here to explore the storybook)
